connector.name: Jira Admin MCP
connector.registryDescription: 78 tools to administer Jira Cloud: issues, fields, workflows, permissions, projects, bulk ops.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package jira-admin-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the its-qusai-nasr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
env.description: Jira Cloud base URL, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

env.name: JIRA_EMAIL
env.description: Atlassian account email that owns the API token

env.name: JIRA_DRY_RUN
env.description: When true, simulate all write operations instead of executing them
